correctness.rationale: The 3-cut complex is generated by complements of disconnected vertex triples of Q3. Rebuilt all 32 facets from the graph definition and verified f=(8,28,56,64,32). Independent boundary ranks over F7 equal (7,21,35,28), matching rational certificate and Betti (1,0,0,1,4). The inspected certificate exhibits explicit integral H3 cycle z and cocycle c with c(z)=1; its verifier tests B3z=0,cB4=0 and evaluates c(gz) for all 48 affine symmetries to obtain sign(σ)(-1)^|b|. Independent reconstruction of chain Lefschetz traces on all 48 automorphisms then yields H4 character (-1)^|b| times the number of fixed antipodal body diagonals. Maschke over Q identifies the 4-dimensional twisted permutation representation. The homological concentration and exact character computations use complete finite exhaustive automorphism enumeration, not a sample.
